inputs.note:
READ ME · SCInsight — Functions & Code Explorer (documentation flow: running it only returns text)
01_fastapi  ->  Agentflow "SCInsight Code Explorer · 01 FastAPI"  (191)  FastAPI — application setup, routes, endpoints, Pydantic models, dependencies
02_business_logic  ->  Agentflow "SCInsight Code Explorer · 02 Business logic"  (144)  Business logic — inventory, BOM, shortages, production, procurement, optimisation, role views
03_sap_data  ->  Agentflow "SCInsight Code Explorer · 03 SAP / data"  (86)  SAP / data — synthetic SAP, OData adapter, SQL / repositories, tenants
04_ai_ml  ->  Agentflow "SCInsight Code Explorer · 04 AI / ML"  (300)  AI / ML — LLM, RAG, forecasting & governed ML, agent tools, LangGraph, evaluation
05_security_governance  ->  Agentflow "SCInsight Code Explorer · 05 Security & governance"  (15)  Security & governance — authentication, authorization, human approval, audit
06_testing  ->  Agentflow "SCInsight Code Explorer · 06 Testing"  (52)  Testing — unit, API, agent tests and smoke tooling
07_flowise_functions  ->  Agentflow "SCInsight Code Explorer · 07 Flowise"  (63)  Flowise — custom JavaScript functions, tool → endpoint mappings, deployment, code maps
Every function node -> its annotated source in a Sticky Note; repository: code_explorer/ (FUNCTION_INDEX.md, viewer/index.html, registry/*.json).
